title: Add median and mode to a stats module
prompt: stats.py only has mean(). Add `median(values)` and `mode(values)`. median of an even-length list is the average of the two middle values. mode returns the most frequent value; on a tie return the smallest of the tied values. Both raise ValueError on an empty list, like mean(). Add unittest tests for them in tests/ (run with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`).
verify: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v && grep -rl --include='test_*.py' -e 'median' tests | grep -v bench_hidden | grep -q .
